search_queries: EGFR knowledgebase retrieval benchmark contradiction evidence tier 2026
verdict: Additive intake only. Adds CIViC-Fact v3's post-cutoff within-linked-publication passage-retrieval evaluation (150 to 66 to 42 to 40 entries, two retriever configurations, both 37/40 appropriate-content on manual review) as a second pan-cancer proxy mapping, distinct from and alongside the already-catalogued CIViC MCP proxy mapping. No EGFR-specific subgroup or score. No duplicate source or mapping is created for CIViC MCP; its existing 30 September 2026 records are unchanged. The one prior active mapping for this use case remains byte-identical; this adds a second active mapping.
remaining_gaps: No independently adjudicated advanced EGFR-mutant NSCLC evidence-retrieval benchmark with prior therapy, treatment line, date, jurisdiction and contradictions was established by this bounded search; see rewire-benchmarks #28 (B345 focused execution gap).

CIViC-Fact v3's post-cutoff retrieval evaluation is within-linked-publication passage retrieval, not open-corpus literature search for a relevant study; this does not establish performance for finding appropriate studies across a clinical corpus.
v2's static stance-classification figures (89%/85%) and the v2-era BGE retrieval figure (70/75) are distinct, version-specific measurements and are not ingested here.
